title: maxChanges=usize::MAX overflow in Message/queryChanges
description: In get_querychanges_since_for_chat: limit = max_changes.saturating_add(1) as i64. If max_changes=usize::MAX (from a client sending maxChanges=18446744073709551615), saturating_add(1) stays at usize::MAX, then as i64 overflows to -1. SQLite interprets LIMIT -1 as no limit. has_more detection fails (rows.len() > n is false since n=usize::MAX). Fix: cap max_changes to a reasonable maximum or use .min(i64::MAX as usize) before the cast.
